description: 覆盖 crosschunk whitelist add/list/set resident/clear 与 preset list 的基础命令路径。

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_add_source
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist add source triggerSource {{source:sync_crosschunk_runtime[0]}}

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_list_source
phases.command: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist list source triggerSource

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_set_target_resident
phases.commandTemplate: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist set target core {{targets[0]}} resident confirm

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_list_target
phases.command: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist list target core

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_clear_source
phases.command: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist clear source triggerSource

phases.name: crosschunk_whitelist_list_source_after_clear
phases.command: redstonelink crosschunk whitelist list source triggerSource

phases.name: crosschunk_preset_list
phases.expectedRegex: (?i)(Presets:|Preset 列表:|No preset configured|当前未配置 preset)
